messages:
anya: Quick sync — Q1 experiments + pricing hook to hit PLG conversions. Need alignment with sales targets and enablement. cc @matt @leila

matt: Got it. Sales target: $1.2M ARR from PLG conversions in Q1 (net new). That implies ~2.5x uplift vs current baseline. Can experiments realistically support that?

leila: Draft experiment plan attached. Pricing hook variants: A) onboarding pack $15/mo, B) 30% time-limited discount, C) feature-gated trial with callbacks. Measuring: conversion_rate, projected LTV, CAC. Draft doc: http://go/redwood/q1-pricing-proposal

sanjay: From eng side — we can implement A/B on the billing modal + feature flag. Need 2 sprints to add event instrumentation and quota checks. ETA Jan 12 for initial telemetry.

carlos: Marketing asks: sales collateral + 1-pager for in-product banners. Need SDR playbook. Enablement window = week of Jan 15. Can design + sales ops have assets by then?

leila: I can own landing + banner copy. Need product spec for onboarding pack features to scope the content. @anya — can you confirm pack scope (docs, starter prompts, templates)?

anya: Confirmed: onboarding pack = 5 starter prompts + 3 templates + 1 "prompt tuning" quickstart guide. No extra infra required. Good for MVP.

matt: Sales needs an objections doc + pricing FAQ. Also propose focusing motion on self-serve expansion accounts (target accounts > $2k ARR). Can analytics produce cohort list?

sanjay: I'll export top 500 self-serve accounts by weekly usage by EOD tomorrow. Also adding event names to track (snippet below):
```
event: onboarding_pack_shown
event: onboarding_pack_purchased
prop: plan_tier
prop: cohort_source
```

carlos: :thumbsup: I'll draft the 1-pager and SDR playbook. Request from sales: a 2-slide pitch + 5 quick rebuttals. Target deliverable Jan 14.

leila: Experiment monitoring plan: weekly dashboard. Primary metric = trials -> paid within 14 days. Secondary = 90-day retention. Stop criteria: no conversion lift at 95% CI after 3 weeks.

anya: Decision: greenlight variants A + B for Q1. Split traffic 50/50. Keep C on hold for post-launch. Launch gating checklist: instrumentation in prod, sales playbook, banner + landing assets. RACI: eng(sanjay), marketing(carlos), product(leila), sales(matt).

matt: Agreed. Soft sales target = 400 net new paid seats by EOY Q1. We'll track weekly and adjust outreach.

carlos: I'll schedule a dry-run enablement on Jan 16 and send calendar invites. :calendar:

leila: Linking experiment doc + tracking sheet: http://go/redwood/q1-experiments (edit access for core team).

anya: Thanks all. I'll update roadmap for leadership. Action items: sanjay export cohort, carlos produce assets, leila finalize spec + dashboard, matt prepare SDR playbook. Ping me on blockers or scope changes.
